description: Burgundy opaque low-square-neck fitted court gown with cream underdress and sleeves, gold-brown woven neckline, cuffs, front and hem edging, thin decorated leather belt with round clasp, small sleeve brooches and burgundy patterned wrap resting along the arms. Small pendant and earrings, brown shoes. Both hands together in front; full side-gather hair and both shoes inside frame. No headgear, armor, weapon or text. Court modifier yields richer textile ornament than minimal landowner trim.
